pr_title: ddl: support column type change from date time type to other types
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/20661

Problem Summary:
DDL modify column, change type from different types, see more detail at: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/19939

### What is changed and how it works?
What's Changed:
Support ddl column type change from date time type(date/datetime/timestamp/time/year) to other types.

According [MySQL data types](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/date-and-time-types.html), date time types include `date/datetime/timestamp/time/year`. 
This PR made some changes:
1. Tested the date time type cast to others(see correlated integration test at column_type_change_test.go).
2. Refine cast inside from date time types(like datetime to year, etc.) to be more reasonable.
3. Refactor ddl_api.CheckModifyTypeCompatible() to be more clearly, which is massive and hard to understand in previous.

Below case cannot supported because of the Datum.ConvertTo() contains no proper implementations about it:
- date/datetime/timestamp/time/year to enum/set/bit

Above case should fix at individual PRs (will create issues later).

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Integration test

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- ddl: support column type change from date time type to other types

issue_context.title: Support conversion from Time types to others
issue_context.body:
## Description

### Background
With the development of the implementation of column type change, we have broken the process into two phases.

1. implement the architecture and column type change between the same type. [phase 1](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/19116)
2. implement the column type change between the different types and some TODO lists. [phase 2](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/19939)

### Problem
Time Types includes:

- Year
- Date/Datetime
- Time/Timestamp
- ...

Support conversion from Time types to others
For example: 

- change Year to String
- change Time to Int
- ...

### Solution
Generally speaking, these changes may all need the reorganize the data, you can refer to the previous issue in phase 1 for the implementation of architecture details. 

In the process of your development, maybe you should also take the SQL Mode into consideration, handling some warnings or errors.

For time type special, you need to take Time Zone into consideration (eg: timestamp type).

- 300

review_comments: I test it on MySQL and get an error, can you please confirm that?

Yes, MySQL will get error as "Invalid JSON....". 
In TiDB, Datum.ConvertTo will treat date time type as string literal, then we'll get result like \"2020-10-30\" .
According to [Working with JSON](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn/JavaScript/Objects/JSON#:~:text=JSON%20can%20actually%20take%20the,may%20be%20used%20as%20properties. ), a simple string may also be a valid JSON, so I think it's more reasonable that TiDB convert it and not to throw an error like MySQL.
Yes, I think we can also keep this.
